quotes.text: When upstream removed deprecated nsICacheEntry MarkValid methods, the Thunderbird port deleted calls in nsImapMockChannel::Close and OnCacheEntryAvailable. An immediate follow-up removed cacheEntry.markValid from an NNTP xpcshell test. Current code contains neither call. For upstream interface removals, search comm production code and tests, including other mail protocols, before treating a small compile fix as complete. No Phabricator review is linked for these two bustage commits.
